title: Forever Building
description: This modpack aims to be a life-time modpack, full of fun and creativity for me and my friends!
body:
This modpack combines Create, Valkyrien Skies, Distant Horizon, and various Terrain Generation mods to create a mod pack you can keep building in forever! Axiom is included, which helps keep users building new things.

This is a forge based modpack for use on a custom server. This modpack contains all the tools (mods) needed to build whatever you could possibly dream using all of the Create mods, as well as Valyrien Skies! The skies are literally your only limit. Then, after you've built eerything you want, wipe it clean off the world using Warium! Have fun, don't be crazy!
